name: Invesco Short Duration US Government Securities Fund
oneLiner: USTB is Invesco's tokenized short-duration Treasury fund, managed by Invesco Advisers on Superstate infrastructure for accredited investors.
collateral: Short-duration U.S. Treasury bills held by The Bank of New York Mellon, with holdings disclosed publicly and liquidity available each market day; managed by Invesco Advisers, Inc.
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting fund share token (not pegged to $1); price launched at ~$10/share and appreciates continuously as Treasury income accrues; subscription and redemption at daily NAV in USDC or USD; NAV calculated by NAV Fund Services each NYSE/Federal Reserve business day

proofOfReserves.provider: PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP (fund auditor); public holdings and on-chain NAV provide daily transparency
proofOfReserves.attestorLicense: SEC-exempt private fund (Reg D Rule 506(c) / ICA §3(c)(7))

jurisdiction.license: Reg D Rule 506(c); Delaware Statutory Trust; restricted to U.S. Qualified Purchasers and Accredited Investors
